ratios.label: Revenue growth
ratios.withheld_reason: Withheld: 9M 2026 and FY2025 are not the same kind of period, so a percentage change between them would compare part of a year with a whole one

valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.ps_withheld_reason: Withheld: the share count behind this market capitalisation is recorded as a DERIVATION, not a source - 'derived from the exchange': a cap built on a count that came from a cap is circular, so every market-based multiple (P/E, P/B, P/S, earnings yield, EV/EBIT) built on it is not a valuation. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
